title: Chapter 902
paragraphs: Chapter 902
Episode 227. New Enemy, Enemy of Enemies (3)
"[Yes, Master. It is certain that Joshua and Kelliark Jifel are cooperating, but I do not think they are a perfect alliance.]"

"That would be the case, steward. Probably, after Joshua first awakened the blood of Ganesto, he would have found Kelliark and healed him. He was dying, being eroded by chaos. Moreover, Sheenu also suffered significant injuries from the former Demon King of the Sun God Religion, which would have been resolved by Lokia."
Jin thought for a moment about what the two's goal could be.
'Kelliark's goal would be to take revenge on Veradin and the members of the family who betrayed him, and to reclaim Jifel. Lokia is trying to use that process for her own purposes.'
Lokia's goal is the overall goal of the Ganesto family.
-Diana, do you think this world is fair?
-What?

-Right. In this world, we are the ones pursuing justice and liberation, but we have no choice but to be more painful than the Jifels, who manipulate all kinds of history and commit atrocities in order to become rulers of the world. Is it really fair?
Suddenly, the words of Lokia he heard in Kaitam's painting came to mind.

'It might be a manifestation of what she thinks is fair, the so-called Lokia's world. She wouldn't have created such a world for mere hobby or personal satisfaction... Perhaps, she wants to destroy the world and replace Inse with the world she created.'
If that's the case, Lokia's actions revealed so far could be somewhat explained.
[From now on, we need to start looking for the space called Lokia's world. I now realize that she really betrayed our family, our past from a thousand years ago…….]

"It won't be easy since she's never been caught off guard against all the major forces of Inse so far. However, looking at the last reaction Anne showed, Lokia might have a weakness related to the Black Sea, so we might be able to get some information from my father and the expedition."
"Indeed, if the expedition returns to Inse, your father should know everything about the Black Sea. I don't know when that will be."

"Of course, we have to keep investigating on our own. We can't recklessly deploy manpower to Lokia, who has almost no clues, while dealing with the Demon World. The priority is still the visible enemies. We need to deal with the Demon World and the enemy clans before we can move on."
The war with the demons and the war with the evil demons.
When those wars are over, the 'final war' that will decide who will control this era would inevitably begin.
The Demon World and the enemy clans, in some respects, might have been a kind of gateway for that final battle.
"Only those who have overcome the underground forces can participate in the final battle.
"Next."

"Zipfel, Kinzelo, Ganesto, Solarism, the royal family. Suddenly, when the Jinma war and the enemy war end, I wonder how many of them will survive and reach out to us. No matter how many survive, we must definitely seize the final victory. We can't keep being tripped up by Jinma and the enemy."
It's always been his thought.
Since Jinma and the enemy invaded humanity, all the huge forces of humanity, including the Vamel alliance, were certainly pushed out of control.
Because Jinma and the enemy always had the initiative based on their warp magic and overwhelming technology.
Among them, Runcandel was insufficient even though Luna was in charge of the pre-emptive attack mission on Jinma.
"That's true. What are you going to do? Kid."

"Now Lokia has started to operate in full swing. Lokia is a sign of wanting to use Jinma with other Ganestos, and Kelliark. So, before that ominous person gets some big gains from it, we have to finish Jinma. Among the enemies, Lokia is the most unpredictable variable."
"Oh, that's quite pleasing to hear. Even I was frustrated that I was just chasing their tails. Then, are you going to attack the barrier now?"

"We will attack the barrier's forces, and you and I will go to the front line. We have been too passive because of the lack of information about them. We cannot annihilate them by only responding in the safest direction."
The pupils of those gathered in the meeting room grew.
Similar conversations had been exchanged a while ago.

Jin also wanted to go to the front line in full scale at that time, but his colleagues persuaded him to hold on until the development of the gold fleet and the mass-produced version of Iello was completed.
Jin respected his colleagues' judgments, but the situation has changed now.
"Youngest, are you serious?"
"Yes, brother."

"We will of course follow your judgment and obey the command. However, the reason why we couldn't take the lead in the Jinma war after the war was not only the lack of information about Jinma, but also because we had to minimize the damage to civilians. We are the rulers of Hupfester, the Vamel alliance, and we have a duty to ensure their safety."

"That's correct. We will not deploy all forces to the barrier front. Of course, we must leave the power to protect the territory. But once they confirm that I and Murakan, including the top combatants of the coalition, have joined the barrier, Jinma will try to spread more cracks in our base."
"Yes, that's exactly what I'm worried about. But I guess you must have thought about it, youngest."
"We're going to press them so hard that they won't even think about creating more fissures in our land than before. I've determined it's possible even without the completion of the Golden Fleet."
"How?"
"Zipfel, and Kinzelo. I intend to get them involved."
Jin recalled an incident that happened at the very beginning of the Demonic War.
It was when Jin had just returned from Lafrarosa.
Jin had realized Rosa had changed and deliberately announced his return to the world before Runcandel, and he headed for the Garden of Swords alone.
Zipfel and Kinzelo, who had been watching the situation at the time, planned to finish Runcandel while Jin and Murakan fought the corrupted Garden of Swords.
As if they had an agreement, both powers led their fleets and troops towards the Garden of Swords.
Now, Jin was painting the same picture.
The moment he first attacks Grosh Castle, all the other powers will join in.
Even if it's not a temporary alliance like during the Demonic War, the Demon Realm is a public enemy that all the giant human forces want to eliminate.
Surely, the Demon Realm had been anticipating the plans of Runcandel, Zipfel, and Kinzelo.
As Jin explained this, Luna and his colleagues nodded their heads.

[Indeed... If it goes as you said, we could effectively press the Demon Realm without completing the Golden Fleet and mass-production of Elero. Recent intelligence suggests that the Red Demon War conducted by the Lutero Federation is somewhat stalled. Current assessment from spies and scholars is that the Red Demons' power seems to have faded. Elona Zipfel lost too many fleets and troops.]

"Instead of the Red Demons acting up, the Demon Realm's transitional rifts keep appearing in the territory of the Lutero Federation. In fact, Elona Zipfel was defeated by Ragal. Now, for Zipfel, the Demon Realm must be more of an eyesore than the Red Demons."
[If the Demon Realm collapses under the simultaneous attack of the three powers, we may be able to use the Golden Fleet and mass-produced Elero in the next war without revealing them.]

"That would be the best-case scenario. Of course, during the simultaneous attack, there will be moments when we have to battle with Zipfel, Kinzelo because the frontlines get intertwined. However, both Veradin and Orgal are not mindless, they won't unnecessarily escalate the conflict among humans."
"The issue of human internal strife can be dealt with after we get rid of the Demon Realm first. But kid, what if Zipfel and Kinzelo don't follow this plan?"
"That won't happen."
"If, by any chance, such a thing happens."

"That's simple. Just recall the newly deployed forces to the base via the barrier. We can immediately share the situation of each front line via the communicator, and the return would be swift with Red Owl and Mort."
"Ah, that makes sense."
"Let's try it first, and even if the enemies don't follow suit, we've almost nothing to lose, unless Zito suddenly appears at our base."
If such a thing were possible, the Vamel Union would have suffered a severe blow long ago.

"Plus, even if Zipfel doesn't move, at least we and Kinzelo will definitely advance. Orgal initially sent reinforcements to the barrier without our request. The Zipfel attacking our base instead of the Demonic World while the Union and Kinzelo are advancing? This also has a slim chance. No matter how hesitant the demonic tribe is, Zipfel won't have the strength to attack our base."
The decision was made.
The union members began to discuss who to select as the superhuman to be additionally deployed to the barrier and how to arrange the troops.
"First of all, Murakan and I will definitely be on the front line, moving with the Golden Fleet. Whether Luna joins us in the breakthrough is crucial..."

[I think it would be good if I, like during the pre-emptive strike mission of the first generation, move like a special forces unit. While Murakan and I break through the front, the first generation could sweep the enemies' defensive line. I can help Murakan and I when needed. And for the third generation...]
Woo-woong!
In the midst of a heated discussion, the communicator vibrated abruptly.
The fourth communication, again, a communication request from Tikan.
{Master Jin! Urgent news just came in. About six hours ago, Zipfel's large fleet started to move. The estimated destination is Grosh Castle!}
At Kashmir's words, Jin's eyes widened.
"......Grosh Castle, you say?"
{Yes, it seems Zipfel is planning to actively deploy troops into the Demonic World.}
The current head of Zipfel is Veradin.
Zipfel starting to attack Grosh Castle means it's Veradin's decision.
'Veradin... he had the same thought as me.'
Jin shrugged his shoulders and looked at his companions.
"Though he is damaged because of Kelliark, there is still a connection between Veradin and me. Since Zipfel has made its move, let's respond promptly."
